title: ShotShield
description: On-device tool that detects and redacts sensitive data (API keys, IBANs, cards, national IDs, emails) in screenshots before you share them. Nothing leaves your machine.

title: HuntKit
description: Local bug bounty recon and methodology copilot. Orchestrates the Kali toolchain, organises findings per program and suggests where to dig next.

title: PacketHighway
description: Real-time 3D network traffic visualization. Every packet becomes a vehicle on a cinematic cyber-city highway.

title: AI-Security-Research
description: Offensive and defensive tools for testing LLM robustness, detecting prompt injection, analyzing network recon and classifying phishing.

title: bugbounty-lab
description: Web-security training labs (IDOR, Broken Access Control, XSS, CSRF) plus bug-bounty writeups. Labs are intentionally vulnerable: run locally only.

title: Cybersecurity-portfolio
description: Hands-on projects, labs and notes on ethical hacking, threat analysis, honeypots, malware analysis and network security.

title: llm-math-solver
description: AI assistant that solves complex math problems with open-source LLMs from Hugging Face, using RAG over a math knowledge base to improve accuracy.

title: fastAPI_projects
description: Collection of FastAPI backend projects focused on AI and cybersecurity applications.

title: Cyber-lab
description: Hands-on cybersecurity lab: Python tools, network analysis, security experiments and penetration testing practice.
